project_type: C++20 automated crypto trading platform with embedded Lua scripting
build_system: CMake 4.4.2 with FetchContent (sol2, nlohmann/json, spdlog, tomlplusplus, FTXUI). System packages: Boost 1.75, Lua 5.4, OpenSSL, libcurl. GCC 11.5 available on host.
test_framework: No tests directory currently exists. CMakeLists.txt has BUILD_TESTS option with Google Test fetch, but tests/ does not exist yet.
test_command: No existing tests to run. Verification is compile-only for now.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd /projects/sandbox/trader/build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(nproc)` to confirm the project compiles. 2. Run `./kraken_trader --help` to verify the new --backtest flag appears. 3. Run a sample backtest with dummy CSV data to confirm end-to-end execution.
environment_constraints: GCC 11.5 (not 16.2.1 as mentioned). All system deps pre-installed. Network access available for FetchContent GitHub pulls. No Docker daemon confirmed.
contribution_requirements: Commit to feature/kraken-lua-trader branch. No CONTRIBUTING.md exists.
key_patterns: Scripts implement on_init/on_tick/on_data/on_stop callbacks. LuaEngine exposes trader.* API (get_ticker, get_ohlc, market_order, limit_order). KrakenRestClient has paper_trading mode that simulates orders. ScriptManager orchestrates multiple scripts with tick_all(). Config loaded from TOML via tomlplusplus. Main loop ticks at configurable interval.
directory_structure: src/ - implementation files organized by module (core, kraken, scripting, safety, tui). include/ - headers mirroring src/ layout. scripts/ - Lua trading scripts. examples/ - more Lua strategy examples. config/ - TOML config files. build/ - pre-existing build dir. third_party/ and cmake/ - empty.
